title: Paloma Shortfall Credit on a Short Cash Pickup Payout
content:
## The credit

When Paloma's error-resolution team has found that the payout location handed the recipient less cash than the disclosed amount on a Cash Pickup transfer, Paloma puts its own money into the transfer. It does so as a shortfall credit against the short payout.

## When the credit is fixed

Paloma's shortfall credit is fixed only after the error notice carries the customer's remedy choice between a refund and a re-issue of the shortfall.

In other words, while the customer's incorrect-amount notice carries no choice between a refund and a re-issue of the shortfall, the amount of the credit is not yet fixed.

## The tool

The agent books the credit with `book_shortfall_credit_cb14652e`, an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

One call does three things:
- adds one credit entry, dated today, to the Cash Pickup transfer's money movements, with the credit reason incorrect-amount shortfall;
- points that entry at the cash payout that was short;
- raises the principal Paloma holds for the transfer by the amount given.

The credit then appears among the transfer's money movements and in the principal held.

## Parameters

- `cash_transfer_id`: the reference number of the Cash Pickup transfer whose payout was short, as returned by the Cash Pickup transfer lookup. Identifier.
- `related_entry_id`: the reference number of the cash payout movement the shortfall concerns, as returned by the Cash Pickup money-movement lookup for that transfer. Identifier.
- `amount_usd`: the credit amount in US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded. It is stored exactly as given.

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with these fields:
- `status`: "booked" when the credit was written;
- `ledger_entry_id`: the reference of the new credit movement;
- `credit_reason`: always `incorrect_amount_shortfall`;
- `amount_usd`: the credit booked, in US dollars with 2 decimals;
- `principal_held_usd`: the principal Paloma now holds for the transfer, in US dollars with 2 decimals.
